description: This file contains unit test templates and test cases for the ClientCertStore component in the net namespace, focusing on client certificate filtering behavior, including issuer filtering and UTF8 string handling.

classes.name: ClientCertStoreTest
classes.description: A templated test class for testing platform-specific implementations of ClientCertStore, providing common test cases for client certificate filtering.

methods.name: EmptyQuery
methods.description: Test that an empty certificate list returns no selected identities.

methods.name: AllIssuersAllowed
methods.description: Test that a certificate is selected when CertRequestInfo has no specific issuer constraints.

methods.name: CertAuthorityFiltering
methods.description: Test filtering of certificates based on specified certificate authorities.

methods.name: PrintableStringContainingUTF8
methods.description: Test handling of certificates with UTF8 strings in subject fields.
